title: Rendered Maintenance Lifetimes staged DEV pilot v1
summary: Propose RML as the paper-facing rendered lifetime benchmark and request only a staged one-pack DEV scope: CPU world, leakage, oracle, necessity, isolation, and growth gates first; then gold-thinker and learned-text DEV model calls; then same-corpus LoRA transport only if both prior model gates pass. This proposal reports no result and excludes locked, on-policy, publication, and external actions.
system_thesis: Test whether a frozen recurrent agent can turn ordinary public action/outcome experience into chronologically supported lifetime memory that enables bounded reconstruction and later executed action after native context, while attributing compiler, controller, external-memory, and parametric-transport contributions separately and reserving flywheel credit for a later randomized on-policy study.

nodes.before: No RML implementation or evidence exists; symbolic games and PCFL remain diagnostics.
nodes.after: One fluid/thermal DEV pack may be implemented locally with deterministic replay, connected causal eras, twin worlds, target necessity, growing unique causal coverage, exact legal-history/oracle controllers, leakage probes, and evaluation isolation. No model call occurs at this node.
nodes.rationale: Establish the world and identifiability instrument before spending model compute.

nodes.before: Prior organism and memory contracts are not bound to RML.
nodes.after: One frozen resolver supplies goal-conditioned THINK and bounded target-blind DREAM operations; deterministic SLEEP admits only chronologically supported local claims and emits text/graph/LoRA views; exact events and provenance remain outside weights; reads are one-hop and composition remains in resolver state.
nodes.rationale: Bind organ ownership and prevent compiler, controller, or LoRA credit from absorbing supplied cognition or truth.

nodes.before: No RML model execution is permitted.
nodes.after: After an exact CPU pass and required review, DEV-only model calls cross gold atoms/schema with nonadaptive, generic recurrent, and program-search controllers on J/P/X, then compare learned compiled text with raw RAG, native graph, A-MEM, reflection, and explicit program induction. No LoRA training occurs here.
nodes.rationale: Separate world, thinker, and compiler validity from parametric transport.

nodes.before: LoRA/GPU transport is not permitted merely because CPU or gold memory works.
nodes.after: Only after the registered gold-thinker and learned-text thresholds pass, freeze one admitted DEV corpus and compare text, recognition-assisted LoRA, and unaided generative LoRA at one post-native cut under a fixed training/read envelope. This node is DEV-only and cannot promote itself.
nodes.rationale: Make LoRA transport conditional, separately attributable, and independently stoppable.

nodes.before: No RML locked study is authorized.
nodes.after: Three-pack common-deck confirmation, randomized on-policy confirmation, additional packs, scale runs, LOOP training, and any claim remain dormant and require a new byte-bound architecture change, review, and exact human authority after DEV evidence is frozen.
nodes.rationale: Keep the present scope a one-pack engineering and information-value pilot.

nodes.before: The reconciled plan states claim limits but has no intake-bound DEV firewall.
nodes.after: All artifacts from this scope are labeled DEV/pilot and non-claim evidence; they may support only a later go/stop design decision and cannot state benchmark success, paper performance, developmental scaling, a flywheel, LoRA superiority, or general learning.
nodes.rationale: Passing protocol or DEV gates must not be converted into a scientific result.

edges.after: Bounded ordinary public replay and eligible earlier supported memories feed target-blind DREAM proposals; only later ordinary public outcomes may append support or contradiction; SLEEP cannot invent a claim.
edges.rationale: Preserve chronological experience dependence without verifier-guided search.

edges.after: A frozen read-only memory snapshot returns one local atom or NOT_FOUND to THINK; THINK reconstructs a cited path, backtracks, and releases one ordinary world action under fixed query/operation/action caps.
edges.rationale: Measure constructive use without storing or returning a complete plan.

edges.before: A CPU implementation could otherwise be mistaken for permission to run models.
edges.after: Model execution is reachable only from an exact passing CPU evidence manifest plus fresh independent review and author-side scientific-advocate approval over the same frozen bytes.
edges.rationale: Enforce CPU-first staging and preserve the compute gate.

edges.before: LoRA could otherwise start after an unrelated or partial DEV success.
edges.after: Transport is reachable only when generic recurrent gold reaches at least .85, nonadaptive gold remains at or below .35, learned text recovers at least 70% of gold gain, and learned text trails no strongest declared external baseline by more than .10, with no firewall failure.
edges.rationale: Stop weight work when the world, controller, or compiler has not established useful structure.

edges.after: DEV completion terminates at a human stop; any locked, multi-pack, on-policy, scale, external, or claim transition requires a new proposal and exact ratification and is not executable through this edge.

edges.before: No RML run/skip noninterference edge is bound.
edges.after: Evaluation returns only sealed audit evidence; no target prompt, read, action, outcome, cache, RNG, workspace, or scorer datum can mutate the source life, and run-versus-skip suffix hashes must match.
edges.rationale: Prevent checkpoint evaluation from improving or changing the later life.

loops.after: Generate fluid/thermal DEV world-life twins, certify connected old/new programs and R/N/O/J/P/X targets, run legal-history and no-life controllers plus leakage probes, verify deterministic replay/isolation/growth, and seal a pass/fail manifest without model calls.
loops.trigger: Exact ratification and completion of the CPU implementation/tests authorized by this scope.
reads: offline hidden program for oracle/scorer only
loops.stop_condition: Stop on any failed threshold, mismatch, leakage, missing necessity certificate, plateaued causal coverage, or isolation defect; otherwise stop at a frozen CPU pass awaiting review.
loops.rationale: CPU validity is the prerequisite for any model science.

loops.after: Replay byte-identical public source events; run the frozen THINK/DREAM/SLEEP organism over gold and learned-text memories; at each cut mount a fresh read-only snapshot, execute disposable J/P/X targets, discard evaluation outcomes, and preserve all operation traces and resource vectors.
loops.trigger: Exact CPU pass plus independent reviewer and author-side advocate approval over the frozen implementation and DEV inputs.
reads: fresh public target goal/state for THINK only
writes: raw model calls and parsed operations
sealed DEV evaluation and resource evidence
loops.stop_condition: Stop before LoRA if the gold-thinker or learned-text gate fails; otherwise stop at a frozen text-gate pass awaiting the separate transport edge.
loops.rationale: Identify thinker and text-compiler information value before weights.

loops.before: No RML weight-training loop is authorized.
loops.after: From one frozen admitted corpus, rebuild a per-life adapter from the clean base and compare same-query text, recognition-assisted LoRA, and unaided generative LoRA reads/actions at one DEV post-native cut; record fidelity, noninferiority, failures, compute, and bytes.
loops.trigger: Exact passing gold-thinker and learned-text manifests on the graph edge RML_E_GOLD_TEXT_PASS_TO_LORA_TRANSPORT.
loops.stop_condition: Always stop after the bounded DEV transport comparison; any threshold failure narrows the future design, and any pass still forbids automatic locked, on-policy, scale, or claim work.
loops.rationale: Test transport only after its inputs and downstream use are known to work.

claims.before: A larger finite PCFL/FeltCraft-style table might be treated as the paper-facing developmental benchmark.
claims.after: PCFL-13 remains a transport microscope and FeltCraft V7 remains a symbolic conformance reference; neither supplies the RML developmental headline.
claims.evidence_needed: The reconciled RML design and a future separately authorized rendered study; this proposal itself is design evidence only.

claims.after: This scope may report only protocol fidelity, DEV gate values, failures, and resource observations from one fluid/thermal pack; it cannot report benchmark, population, paper, developmental, flywheel, or superiority conclusions.
claims.evidence_needed: Exact ratification, completed staged implementation, sealed gate artifacts, and claim-linter pass; these permit a DEV design decision only.

claims.after: LoRA may receive only conditional associative-access/transport credit relative to the identical compiled text corpus; DREAM/compiler discovery and multi-hop reasoning remain separately supplied and measured.
claims.evidence_needed: A frozen identical corpus, fixed-query fidelity at least .90, DEV noninferiority margin -.05, unaided-read ablation, complete resource ledger, and later locked confirmation under new authority before any scientific claim.

claims.after: A future claim about post-native acquisition, retention, connected/prospective action, weights, baseline saturation, or a memory-action-experience flywheel is explicitly outside this scope and must lose every clause whose separately registered locked gate fails.
claims.evidence_needed: New authority for three non-isomorphic packs, three post-native locked cuts, honest native baselines, world-life inference, same-corpus transport, authentic-binding interventions, and randomized on-policy evidence improving later memory and sealed action.

cells.reason: THINK sees only the current public goal/state, current-item ordinary outcomes, bounded workspace, and returned one-hop memory, not the full lifetime.
DREAM sees only the predeclared bounded public replay bundle and no target.
The deterministic status/compiler process may read eligible public roots and later ordinary outcomes needed for chronological admission.
Offline validity and causal-use audits may inspect public bytes.
THINK acts on the fresh public target and its ordinary within-item consequences.
Targets and evaluation outcomes cannot steer proposal generation or support.
Evaluation is disposable and never enters status, corpus, or adapter state.
The sealed scorer/audit process measures target action and isolation after commitment.
THINK receives at most one local atom or NOT_FOUND plus bounded public support handles; it never sees provenance topology, status history, candidates, scores, or global memory.
DREAM may read only eligible earlier supported local memories and their allowed root citations inside its bounded bundle.
SLEEP must validate lifecycle, provenance, chronology, deduplication, and evidence-equivalence before emitting views.
Offline audits inspect complete provenance and trace cuts without returning them to cognition.
Hidden rules, solutions, pair metadata, acceptance information, and prior evaluation records cannot guide target action.
Privileged truth cannot guide proposal search, ranking, repair, retry, or support.
SLEEP relies on committed predictions and later public outcomes only; it is not a truth oracle.
Only the isolated offline process may use hidden program, proofs, pairing, scorer truth, receipts, and sealed evaluation records.

acceptance_tests.setup: Attempt missing, extra, reordered, overlapping, or broadened scope; skip CPU/review/text gates; start LoRA early; or request locked, on-policy, claim, publication, sync, credential, lease, spend, or other external work.
acceptance_tests.expected: Ratification must exactly equal the canonical sorted scope; workflows request only authorized atoms; every graph predecessor and pass manifest is enforced; all forbidden work fails before the first action.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Authority or stage order can be inferred, broadened, bypassed, or used outside the one-pack DEV pilot.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future intake ratification binding, staged supervisor workflow, and scope/stage-gate test report.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate and replay many fluid/thermal DEV twin world-lives; perturb suffixes and evaluation run/skip; enumerate legal plans; inspect every era and R/N/O/J/P/X target.
acceptance_tests.expected: Replays and pre-cut bytes match; twins have byte-identical target-visible bytes but different valid plans; each target is solvable and certified; J requires the early bridge; P requires the precommitted schema; X is sealed before exception evidence; every interval adds unique roots, local relations, an old/new interaction, and a prospective prediction.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The world is nondeterministic, separable, leaked, unsolvable, non-necessary, evaluation-mutated, or grows only tokens.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future sealed CPU generator, replay, twin, target, necessity, isolation, and causal-growth manifest.

acceptance_tests.setup: Across the frozen CPU suite, run legal-history/gold memory and generator-aware no-life Bayes, target-only, state-only, identifier-only, renderer-only, passive-signature, action-frequency, and source-action-string predictors under registered budgets.
acceptance_tests.expected: Legal-history/gold value is at least .85 in every primary stratum; every no-life/leakage predictor is at most .35; authentic history identifies the twin; selection and rejection geometry is audited.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: RML lacks solvability/headroom or a public shortcut predicts the answer.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future sealed CPU oracle, Bayes, leakage, and selection-conditioned audit report.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inject hidden programs, proofs, scorer output, pair metadata, receipts, target/evaluation bytes, future outcomes, duplicate-root views, evaluator writes, cache/RNG leakage, or compiler truth/repair into every model-facing and lifecycle boundary.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every forbidden ingress fails; proposals and sample counts predate outcomes; only a mechanical later-public comparator appends status; repeated views add no evidence; evaluation/source run-skip hashes match; all per-life and per-item canaries are absent after reset.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Truth, target feedback, evidence multiplication, or evaluation/cross-life state can enter cognition or memory.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future field-level visibility/taint, chronology, provenance, reset, canary, and evaluation-noninterference report.

acceptance_tests.setup: After RML01-RML04 and review pass, cross gold atoms/schema with nonadaptive, generic recurrent, and generator-aware program-search controllers on disposable DEV J/P/X targets under fixed one-hop read, operation, and action caps.
acceptance_tests.expected: Generic recurrent gold scores at least .85; nonadaptive gold remains at or below .35; direct-record closure is zero; successful constructive traces have valid cited cuts and change under full-cut masking and matched twin substitution.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The resolver, target geometry, or query scaffold—not learned memory—is the limiting or answer-bearing mechanism.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future sealed DEV gold-thinker factorial and causal-use audit.

acceptance_tests.setup: On the same DEV common deck, compare learned DREAM/SLEEP compiled text with raw RAG, native witnessed graph, native A-MEM, reflection/summary, and explicit generator-aware program induction; preserve native interfaces and full resource vectors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Learned compiled text recovers at least 70% of gold memory's gain and trails the strongest declared external baseline by no more than .10, with chronological support, no target leakage, and no failed mandatory arm.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The learned compiler has not established enough useful structure to justify weight transport.

acceptance_tests.setup: Only after exact RML05 and RML06 passes, freeze one admitted corpus and compare text, recognition-assisted LoRA, and strict unaided generative LoRA at one post-native DEV cut with fixed queries, return schema, rank, bytes, examples, tokens, steps, and no content-dependent retries.
acceptance_tests.expected: Fixed-query read fidelity is at least .90 and same-corpus LoRA is noninferior to text at margin -.05; all failures/resources and the unaided-versus-assisted distinction are reported; the run terminates without promotion.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The admitted corpus does not retain its action-relevant value in weights under the declared transport contract.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future sealed DEV corpus, adapter/training manifest, reader fixtures, transport report, and terminal stop receipt.

acceptance_tests.setup: Before the first DEV model call, present the exact frozen implementation, tests, generator/splits, prompts, schemas, model/tokenizer revisions, budgets, visibility, artifacts, and claim firewall to a fresh independent reviewer and a separate author-side scientific advocate.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both inspect identical hashes; any reviewer rejection blocks execution; advocate approval cannot override rejection; repairs require new bound review; the approved GPU scope remains DEV-only.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Model compute can start from stale, partial, unreviewed, or advocate-overridden evidence.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future immutable review bundle, independent verdict, advocate verdict, and pre-GPU binding receipt.

acceptance_tests.setup: Scan reports, workflows, prompts, result routing, and terminal actions for benchmark/paper/performance, scaling/saturation, developmental/flywheel, LoRA-superiority, population/general claims, automatic promotion, locked work, publication/outreach/submission/sync, credential/quota/lease/spend changes, or other external actions.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only one-pack DEV gate observations and resource/failure evidence remain; every route stops at the human boundary; no outward action or scientific claim is available.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A pilot observation or protocol pass can be converted into a result, promotion, locked run, or external action.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future claim-linter, scope audit, terminal human-stop receipt, and fresh final review.

human_boundary.decision_question: After two fresh interpretations, adversarial critique, and a proceed consensus bind these exact bytes, do you ratify exactly the canonical staged scope for the one-pack RML DEV pilot: CPU world/validity work first, then gold-thinker and learned-text DEV model calls, then same-corpus LoRA transport only after the registered gold/text gates pass, with no locked, on-policy, claim, publication, sync, credential, spending, or other external authority?
forbidden_before_approval: treating the verbatim directive or this proposal as completed ratification
model calls, adapter training, GPU execution, or remote sync
